jobs.description: Careers Operations – Finyx Technology Development & Investment Company Curios minds from the fields of science, mathematics, physics and financial engineering working together to create winning trading strategies. Through our advanced computing environment, we constantly research, map and sequencing financial behaviours, developing them into trading algorithms with the optimal balance between risk and reward. Filter: All Operations Technology Operations | Israel System Operator We are looking for a System Operator to join a team of champions! What you’ll be doing? We are looking for a brilliant algorithmic trading system operator to integrate into an amazing team in the trading room. The team is responsible for all operations, maintenance and investigation of the trading systems. In addition, the team is responsible for routine control of the capital market and the indices traded. No need to come with prior knowledge or experience. We provide all the necessary training for the job. This is a rare opportunity to join one of the most successful companies in its field, to join a team of brilliant people and to enter the field of Algotrading, which combines both technology and the capital market. What you’ll need? BA in Economics / Business Administration / Accounting from a leading universities with high grades Strong knowledge of Excel Willingness to work full-time Would be very nice if you have? jobs.title: Technology
jobs.description: Careers Technology – Finyx Technology Development & Investment Company Curios minds from the fields of science, mathematics, physics and financial engineering working together to create winning trading strategies. Through our advanced computing environment, we constantly research, map and sequencing financial behaviours, developing them into trading algorithms with the optimal balance between risk and reward. Filter: All Operations Technology Technology | Israel Senior Software Developer We are looking for top notch senior C++ developer to join a team of champions! What you’ll be doing? Work closely with our trading rooms, in which you will immediately see the profits of the code you have written Enrich and deepen your knowledge in capital market in a way you cannot imagine! Take part and also benefit directly from the success of the company and the profits of the strategy you will develop Depending on your skills and aspirations, in the future you will also be able to engage in the development of algorithms (based on Machine and Deep Learning) and in the development of complex trading strategies. Actively lead and participate in the features development Analyze features requirements, create design documents and review them with relevant stake holders in the company Encourage continuous improvement in the development process and ensure efficient delivery of products Participate in reviewing design and code of other team members Deliver high quality, sustainable and maintainable code. What you’ll need? B.Sc. in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent At least 3 years of experience in C ++ development (Specific C++ 11) Experience in Win environment – Must Experience in Python – Must Would be very nice if you have? Experience in Linux environment Experience in infrastructure development Experience working with AWS Send CV > Technology | Israel Senior Data Scientist We are looking for top notch Senior Data Science to join a team of champions! What you’ll be doing? We are looking for a top-notch Senior Data Scientist who will excel in analyzing large amounts of data, developing advanced quantitative models, and optimizing proprietary predictions and trading algorithms. You will be required to perform out of the box thinking, engage in complex problem-solving discussions from research to production, help shape existing algorithms, and improve our monitorization processes. The position is suited for people who are capable of absorbing an extensive amount of data while maintaining a strong focus on the finer details. The key attributes needed are mastery of MATLAB, strong quantitative logic, and core statistical knowledge. What you’ll need? BSc in relevant fields (CS/EE/Physics/Math/Biomed) from in a leading university with Excellency. Strong mathematical capabilities & programming skills Strong knowledge of MATLAB or Python Ability to collaborate with peers and handle several tasks simultaneously Would be very nice if you have? MSc in relevant field (CS/EE/Physics/Math/Biomed) from in a leading university with Excellency. Experience with Statistical algorithms.
